projectDescription: Hero is a map-based geography and history quiz web app built as a static site with Firebase and EdgeOne serverless functions, featuring AI-assisted study tools, Canvas LMS integration, and user accounts.
keyFeatures: Map-based geography and history quiz with identify and find game modes
Clio AI study guide powered by Google Gemini with image upload support
Canvas LMS integration for grades, assignments, and announcements
Username-based account system with private one-time recovery codes
Weak spots tracking synced to Firebase Firestore
Push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging
Curated GeoJSON map boundaries from Natural Earth and historical datasets
Admin/Steward panel with dev mode, announcements, and remote redeploy
Feature flags to enable/disable individual app features
Tailwind CSS theming with dark mode support
publicApiSurface: POST /api/auth — admin and dev-access password verification, returns signed admin token
POST /api/chat — Gemini-powered AI chat (Clio), requires Firebase ID token
POST /api/canvas — same-origin relay for Canvas LMS read-only API requests
POST /api/deploy — create empty Git commit and trigger EdgeOne redeploy webhook
POST /api/push-announcement — send FCM push notification to opted-in browsers
GET /api/push-config — return VAPID public key for Web Push subscription
POST /api/account-recovery — save or verify one-time username account recovery codes
window.__heroShowAuthGate() — open auth dialog from a blocked view
window.__heroRegionHint(loc) — return region hint string for a quiz location
window.__heroSendAnnouncementPush(title, body) — send push from admin session
window.__heroDeviceProfiles — device profile map for admin tooling
SITE object in js/00-site-config.js — site name, id, version, tagline, feature flags
